bio.name: Baraa Shareet
paragraphs: My work started from a strong affinity for digital media and aesthetics, and from a curiosity for materials, forms, and colour. My studio is based in Wuppertal, framed by valley and river, where I develop and refine my renderings.
My vision is to translate architectural concepts into visual impressions that open up tomorrow’s perspectives and add individual accents to each project.
Approaching the realisation of your ideas with care and dedication is at the core of my practice.
Studium – Bergische Universität Wuppertal, 2021 M. Sc. Architecture.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: I enjoy speaking about images and architecture. If you would like to discuss a project or have any questions, you are welcome to call or send an email.
